LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets the donor add a transaction fee calculated by the flow, and shows it formatted like the FinDock Pay button.

property.name: fee
property.label: Fee
property.description: The fee the donor can add, usually a formula, for example a percentage of the selected amount rounded to the currency's decimals. A fee with more decimals than the currency has is not offered.

property.name: currencyIsoCode
property.label: Currency ISO Code
property.description: The currency the Pay button charges in. Leave empty to use the org currency.

property.name: label
property.label: Label
property.description: Use {0} for the fee. To translate it, use a custom label, as the templates do with {!$Label.ec_transaction_fee_opt_in}.

property.name: helpText
property.label: Help Text
property.default: Add a small amount so 100% of your gift supports the mission.
property.description: Optional text under the checkbox. To translate it, use a custom label, as the templates do with {!$Label.ec_transaction_fee_help_text}.

property.name: value
property.label: Fee Selected
property.description: True when the donor selects the checkbox. Input and output, so the choice is kept when the donor goes Back and Next. Do not pre-select it: pre-ticked extra payments are not allowed in the EU and UK.

property.name: addedFee
property.label: Added Fee
property.description: The fee when the donor selects the checkbox, otherwise 0. Add it to the charged amounts and map it to the Pay button's Transaction Fee Amount.
